Interface Readable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ExcelReadable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    EventExcelReader, ReadCSV, ReadWorkbook, UpdateWorkbook

    public interface Readable
extends java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>
    Defines the contract for reading tabular data sources, such as spreadsheets and CSV files.

    Implementations provide mechanisms to open and close data resources, inspect data dimensions, locate columns by cell content or regular expression, and iterate over rows represented as arrays of strings.

    Implementations may require open() to be called before data can be accessed. Resources should be released by calling close().
